summary: In late October 2026 an external attacker exploited a vulnerability in a third-party vendor used in the infrastructure of Warp, a developer terminal and agentic development environment, exposing AI agent decision logs and telemetry data for roughly 1% of Warp's 800,000+ users. Analysts described the attack as an 'agent swarm' using a sophisticated penetration and escalation technique. Warp detected and remediated the activity within hours, engaged CrowdStrike, notified affected users and law enforcement, and did not say whether source code, prompts or credentials were exposed.
